recorded_statement: Prove existence of absolutely continuous spectrum (delocalised states) for the random Schrodinger operator -Delta + lambda V on Z^3 at small disorder lambda, and GOE local statistics for its finite-volume restriction.

recorded_source.locator: intake cites Section 2.1, p. 7; the survey introduction also states the paired extended-states/GOE goal

historical_context.scope: extended or continuous spectrum for an iid site-potential lattice model in dimension above two; tree results are distinct

later_claim.claim_scope: uniform independent site disorder; pure a.c. spectrum with nonzero weight on an open interval for every fixed d>=3 at sufficiently small positive disorder

proof_gate: Do not claim parent solution from the intake, a preprint abstract, or a partial lemma; inspect load-bearing spectral steps and independent review.
